summary: The Playwright test artifact is syntactically correct, compiles without errors, and uses Playwright APIs properly. Each product card locator is awaited and asserted for visibility. The test case ID TC-001 is preserved in the test title. However, there is a large number of repetitive assertions which impacts maintainability and reusability. Selectors use data-test attributes which are stable and recommended. No asynchronous Playwright mistakes or invalid API usage found.

issues.description: The test contains repetitive assertions for 26 product cards without loops or helper functions, making it hard to maintain and extend.
issues.recommendation: Use loops or utility functions to iterate over product identifiers and assert visibility to improve maintainability and reduce code duplication.

recommendations: Introduce iteration over product data attributes to reduce repetitive code.
Consider adding checks on content or other attributes of product cards to strengthen assertions beyond visibility.
Keep URL as a config or test fixture instead of hardcoding if that aligns with project conventions.
